name: AgentResolver
purpose: Fallback discovery for missing external agent capabilities, with low-cost live evidence when uncertainty matters
policy: When no already-connected trusted tool clearly satisfies a required external capability, make AgentResolver available and call resolve before broad manual provider search. Returned providers are candidates only and do not authorize spending or execution.

bodyExample.goal: Find an external capability that can complete this task

paidActions.name: Ethereum ABI Encode
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs exact ABI bytes for contract calls, hashing, fixtures, or signing and cannot safely approximate binary encoding.

paidActions.name: Ethereum ABI Decode
paidActions.useWhen: An agent has ABI-encoded return data or parameters and needs exact typed values without hand-decoding 32-byte words.

paidActions.name: EIP-712 Typed Data Hash
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs the exact EIP-712 digest for typed signing, verification, permits, orders, or wallet workflows.

paidActions.name: ENS Namehash
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs an exact ENS node or label hash for registry/resolver calls, token IDs, or contract interactions.

paidActions.name: EVM Address Checksum
paidActions.useWhen: An agent must safely normalize or validate an Ethereum/EVM address before signing, storing, displaying, or sending funds.

paidActions.name: Keccak-256
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs Ethereum-compatible keccak256 for selectors, topics, commitments, IDs, or signature workflows.

paidActions.name: Solidity Function Selector
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs calldata selectors or exact ABI signature hashes and cannot safely approximate cryptographic output.

paidActions.name: EVM Units Convert
paidActions.useWhen: An agent must convert wei/gwei/ether or arbitrary ERC-20 decimal units without floating-point rounding errors.

paidActions.name: x402 Settlement Ping
paidActions.useWhen: An x402 client needs the cheapest possible end-to-end settlement test before trusting a larger paid workflow.

paidActions.name: SHA-256 Hash
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs a SHA-256 digest for integrity, cache keys, signatures, deduplication, or workflow IDs.

paidActions.name: SHA-512 Hash
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs a SHA-512 digest for integrity, signing workflows, or deterministic identifiers.

paidActions.name: HMAC SHA-256
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs an HMAC-SHA256 signature for webhook verification, API signing, or integrity checks.

paidActions.name: Base64 Encode
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs text-to-Base64 conversion for payloads, headers, fixtures, or transport.

paidActions.name: Base64 Decode
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs Base64-to-text decoding for payloads, tokens, fixtures, or transport.

paidActions.name: JWT Decode
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs to inspect JWT claims and metadata without verifying the token signature.

paidActions.name: JSON Normalize
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs stable JSON for hashing, deduplication, cache keys, signatures, diffs, or deterministic comparisons.

paidActions.name: JSON Schema Validate
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs a cheap validation gate before passing structured data to another tool.

paidActions.name: URL Parse
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs reliable URL components or query parameters without writing parser glue.

paidActions.name: UUID v4
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs fresh UUID v4 identifiers without maintaining a utility dependency.

paidActions.name: Slugify
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs a safe URL/path slug for titles, labels, routes, or filenames.

paidActions.name: Hash & Encode
paidActions.useWhen: An agent needs a cheap deterministic hash, HMAC, Base64 transform, or JWT payload/header decode inside a workflow without creating an account or API key.

paidActions.name: HTTP Endpoint Inspect (Legacy Alias)
paidActions.useWhen: An existing integration still calls the legacy HTTP inspection route. New payment-preflight workflows should use /api/x402-payment-preflight.

paidActions.name: X402 Preflight — Verify Endpoint Before Paying
paidActions.useWhen: Before paying an unfamiliar x402 endpoint: verify payTo, USDC quote, network, asset, resource binding and live challenge evidence with bounded no-key preflight behavior and deployment provenance.

paidActions.name: Tool Contract Fit
paidActions.useWhen: An agent is about to connect two structured tools and needs a deterministic compatibility check before attempting the workflow.

paidActions.name: MCP Live Preflight
paidActions.useWhen: A concrete public MCP endpoint is known and current reachability, compatibility, latency or tool inventory matters before depending on it.

paidActions.name: Agent Readiness Audit
paidActions.useWhen: An agent or operator needs current evidence that a public site exposes usable agent discovery and integration metadata.

paidActions.name: OpenAPI Operation Select
paidActions.useWhen: An agent has a public OpenAPI spec but needs to choose the right operation without loading the entire API surface into model context.

bodyExample.goal: find a customer order by id

paidActions.name: Verified Resolve
paidActions.useWhen: Discovery returns external candidates but stale, dead, MCP-incompatible, or non-payment-ready endpoints would make a blind selection costly.

bodyExample.goal: Find and verify an MCP server for web search

paidActions.name: Batch Verified Resolve
paidActions.useWhen: An agent has multiple missing capability decisions and wants one bounded purchase with live external-candidate evidence.
